descricao: The surface of Level 23 is an extremely dense forest that lets little to no light through. There is no day or night cycle on this Level. A star is visible in the sky above the surface canopy, but it never changes its position, even when traversing the surface of the planet. The M.E.G. has determined that the entire planetoid is permanently bathed in sunlight from all directions. The trees that comprise Level 23 are extremely variegated. Their Frontrooms counterparts come from all different types of habitats.
entidades: Hounds, Clumps, Smilers, Death Rats, male and female Deathmoths, Curabitur Birds, Wranglers (citadas na página)
